findings.title: No View Transitions integration — the biggest 2025–26 platform primitive kf ignores
findings.detail: grep -rn startViewTransition|ViewTransition|view-transition src/ returns zero hits. Same-doc View Transitions are Baseline (Chrome 111, Safari 18, Firefox 144); cross-doc + typed + view-transition-class are shipping. kf's flipShared is the same shared-element idea at a lower altitude. Highest-leverage uplift: a light viewTransition() dispatch that falls back to flipShared where unavailable, plus teaching compileToCSS to emit ::view-transition-* @keyframes + view-transition-class — the moat move no other engine can make (compile TO View Transitions). Lands in orchestration/view-transition/ + a compile/ emitter branch; risk low-medium.

Risk low.

findings.title: No @starting-style / allow-discrete entry-exit path; presets predate the native primitive
findings.detail: grep starting-style|allow-discrete|transition-behavior in src/animation/ returns zero hits. These became Baseline Newly Available (Chrome 117+, Safari 17.5+, Firefox 129+) — animating in from display:none without JS is now native. kf's fadeIn/slideIn presets and compile/backward.ts have no awareness. Uplift: teach compileToCSS to emit the @starting-style + transition-behavior:allow-discrete couplet (the boilerplate everyone gets wrong needs both) so kf compiles to the CURRENT-spec entry animation, not just an animation shorthand. Additive, feature-detected on consume side; risk low.

findings.title: animation-trigger is parsed and round-tripped but not driven

But no ScrollScene backend realizes trigger behavior (play-forwards/backwards on offset crossing). Native animation-trigger lands Chrome 145 only (mid-2026). kf's ScrollScene already resolves ranges against the DOM, so driving a discrete trigger state machine is a small extension that gives kf a cross-browser animation-trigger — mirroring how ScrollScene fills the FF/Safari scroll-timeline gap. Conversely kf's resolve/ zone resolves if()/@function/env() in JS while if() (Chrome 137) and @function (Chrome 139) are Chromium-ONLY — kf is ahead of cross-browser platform support, an under-stated marketing asset. Anchor-aware ElementMorph/flipShared is low-demand nice-to-have; surfacing the resolver as a headline is zero-code high-value.

findings.title: Per-parse packrat-epoch allocates 3 Maps on the DEFAULT non-memoized path — flows to every value.js/kf parse
findings.detail: parser.ts:43 calls packratEnter() on every top-level parseState(); packrat.ts:189-203 allocates MEMO/HEADS/GROWING = new Map() unconditionally. The 'no-op-cost reference swap' comment (parser.ts:36-42) is inaccurate — it is 3 Map constructions + 1 restore per parse. value.js NEVER opts into parse-that's packrat (uses its own memoize at value.js/src/utils.ts:116; 0 mergeMemos/resetPackrat hits), so this is pure overhead per CSS value keyframes.js compiles. Fix: PACKRAT_ARMED flag flipped in makeMemoized (packrat.ts:244), early-return no-op enter/exit until armed. The single measurable consumer-facing perf win.

findings.detail: All 15 *Span combinators carry '@deprecated 0.13.0, remove in 1.0.0' (span.ts:13-25) with zero constellation consumers (confirmed 0 hits across value.js; kf has zero direct parse-that imports). findings.title: chain() gates the continuation on value truthiness, silently skipping it for 0/''/false
findings.detail: parser.ts:124-140: chain runs fn only when `state.value || chainError`. A successfully-parsed falsy value (0, empty string, false) skips the continuation and returns the seed instead of threading — no error surfaced. value.js uses .chain at 4 sites (currently non-falsy CSS tokens). Fix: gate on !state.isError only, keep chainError as the opt-in escape; add a 0/''-yielding regression test. Patch semver.

R.W1 §2f excised the granular loaders citing zero call sites (load-engine.ts:213). Load-time/bundle cost only, not CPU — mitigated by parallel chunk fetch + warmEngine. BOOK a facet-lazy split for S only if a real bundle-budget consumer emerges.

findings.title: Hot loops byte-preserved; Q-era SoA fold + zero-alloc buffers survived the carve intact
findings.detail: interpFrames/processFrame are module free functions with a single-frame alias fast-path and delete-free clearBuffer (engine/interpolate.ts:120-287). The numeric SoA fold (_numericPlan, lerpArray) pre-existed R at git show a15cd48:src/animation/engine.ts:805-816; R.W2b only relocated the plan builder to compile/numeric-plan.ts. Physics steppers use module-level Float64Array scratch (physics/numeric.ts:25). SoA claims substantiated by scripts/processframe-soa-decision.json (60x) + soa-composite-decision.json (4.68x add).

findings.title: src/animation/CLAUDE.md still describes the pre-R flat layout
findings.detail: CLAUDE.md:42-44,78,91 name flat engine.ts/frame-compiler.ts/group.ts and the class Animation (renamed KeyframesAnimation in Q). R.W8 refreshed root + demo CLAUDE.md (5a5f7db) but not the animation-zone doc, misdirecting a perf reader mapping the hot path. Fold the refresh into the S sub-zoning wave.

findings.title: LIGHT-barrel tree-shaking is clean
findings.detail: index.ts:30-266 is pure re-exports; the one module side-effect (registerGroupFactory, group/index.ts:27) is on the HEAVY/dynamic side, so light-only consumers never evaluate it. No static @mkbabb/value.js runtime edge in physics/ or orchestration/ (grep confirms only import type + comments), enforced by proof:boundary.

implications: S-PERF-1 (folds F3): precompute boxedKeys as a Set into SoALayerPlan at buildSoAPlans so boxedBlendArm stops allocating per frame; extend proof:soa-composite/zero-alloc to bite the residual color-tail path (currently unguarded).

S-PERF-2 (SOTA uplift): resolve the Typed-OM write-path adopt/kill — carry bench/typed-om-validate.mjs to a real-browser bench; if ADOPT, route transformTargetsStyle through attributeStyleMap.set to skip serialize->reparse on the DOM apply channel.

S-PERF-3: WAAPI densify — densify multi-segment CSS-twin easing into a single linear() so more fromString animations qualify for the compositor thread (bench/waapi-densify.bench.ts exists; waapi.ts still rejects multi-segment easing).

S-PERF-4 (BOOK, do not manufacture): facet-lazy loading behind loadAnimationEngine only if an S bundle-budget consumer materializes; first run a cold-cache transfer/parse bench to prove the non-fromString chunks are a real cost.

S-METHOD warning: R's zero-alloc holds because hot functions are free functions over the CONCRETE anim/group reading fields directly. Any S sub-zone (engine/css/, compile/backward/) that re-homes a hot function must preserve this DI-by-concrete-argument pattern — no per-frame adapter object, no interface-typed collaborator on the interp/compositor path.
S-DOC (folds F6): refresh src/animation/CLAUDE.md to the zone layout inside the sub-zoning wave; it is pre-R stale and will be rewritten by the zone split anyway.

Bottom line: do NOT reverse any R carve for perf reasons — the DI carves are cold-path and the PlaybackState carve improved the design. Spend S's perf budget extending the SoA/Typed-OM/WAAPI frontier.

design.headline: The CRT reliquary is genuinely built and honestly engine-driven, but its three best interactions are unadvertised secrets, its decay() proof is occluded by the mobile sheet, and the phosphor overlay glows over a room that never got dark.
design.grade: B+ — distinctive, deeply dogfooded engineering (decay telemetry, CRT boot, flick egg) undercut by zero on-stage affordance text, a mobile-occluded telemetry chip, a light-mode-invisible CRT identity, and one reduced-motion hole on the dblclick boing.
refinements: Un-occlude the ω telemetry on mobile: move .amiga-telemetry (AmigaTelemetry.vue:52-54) to top-left under a small-viewport media query so the decay() witness survives the bottom sheet — ~6 lines of CSS, highest leverage.

Land the dropped P2 gesture caption: a Fira Code micro-caption ('drag to spin · double-click to boing'; coarse-pointer copy 'flick hard to boing') beside the telemetry chip in AmigaScene.vue, fading after first spin — fixes the surviving A5 discoverability defect.
PRM-gate the dblclick boing: add the prm.value === 'reduce' guard (already on the flick path, AmigaScene.vue:93-96) to onBoing itself (AmigaScene.vue:141) — 2 lines, closes the reduced-motion hole.

Theme the room walls: replace the raw rgb(220,220,220) Lambert literal (useAmigaThree.ts:167-169) with a theme-resolved value via the resolveColor idiom (utils.ts:14), darker in dark mode so the phosphor vignette finally glows against a tube-dark room.
Strengthen the CRT stack in light mode: bump light scanline/vignette mix a notch and add the designed ~3% grain layer (AmigaCrtOverlay.vue:46-89) so the page identity is not dark-mode-only.

Sphere-hover phosphor breath: on raycast-hover (raycaster already in useSphereSpin.ts:74,106) nudge --spin-bloom to ~0.15 so the CRT 'notices' the ball — signals the ball-grab vs orbit-grab two-gesture model with zero new chrome.

Peak-hold tick + threshold notch on the ω bar (AmigaTelemetry.vue:81-97): hold the last flick's max ~2s and mark FLICK_BOING_RAD_S (useSphereSpin.ts:68) as a faint notch — makes the hidden 8 rad/s egg threshold learnable, converting the egg into a game.

First-visit boot amnesty: one PRM-gated flash-only power-on (pure CSS on AmigaCrtOverlay, no engine arc — proof:cold-entry inviolate) on cold arrival (AmigaScene.vue:176-193 + useAmigaBoot.ts) so first-time visitors don't get the page's weakest state.
design.easter_egg: "Guru Meditation" — over-flick the ball past ~2.5× the boing threshold (≥ ~20 rad/s, top of the calibrated range in useSphereSpin.ts:63-68) and the CRT crashes like a real 1984 Amiga: a black top-of-stage band with a blinking --amiga-red double border and Fira Code text 'Software Failure. Press left mouse button to continue. / Guru Meditation #00000004.0000AAC0', held ~2.5s, then the existing runBoot() power-on replays as the reboot. One overlay div + existing tokens + the existing boot composable; PRM-gated like every other egg; discovered exactly by the users already playing hardest.
mobile_issues: The ω telemetry chip (bottom-left, AmigaTelemetry.vue:52-54) is occluded by the bottom sheet + dock at 375px — the page's decay() proof is invisible on the platform where the flick gesture is most natural.
No touch affordance for the boing: double-tap-fires-dblclick is unstated and the 8 rad/s flick threshold is unknowable — the egg is effectively sealed on touch.

The sphere is a small grab target (~90px) and every miss is silently claimed by OrbitControls; with touch-action:none (AmigaScene.vue:273) the stage also never scrolls, so a confused first touch reads as 'stuck'.
The dock (Rotations/reset/trash/play) overlaps the sheet's top edge, competing with the sheet drag handle in the same thumb zone.
The CRT identity nearly vanishes on mobile light mode — 9%-alpha multiply scanlines over the light-gray room read as a generic gray 3D viewer.
